findings.title: ECS task definition with host networking
findings.description: network_mode = "host" gives containers full access to the host network namespace, bypassing Docker network isolation.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: ECS container without log configuration
findings.description: A container in aws_ecs_task_definition's container_definitions without logConfiguration sends stdout/stderr only to the Docker daemon log, which is ephemeral and invisible to CloudWatch. Add a logConfiguration with the awslogs driver so container output is centralized and auditable.
findings.remediation: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.
